rule: Uncertains and dual-screen disagreements adjudicated from abstract; genuinely unresolvable I2 cases marked include-provisional and confirmed at full-text extraction (demotion logged with criterion) — the program's established pattern.
boundary_rules_added: B1: retrieval/search systems whose output feeds a developer or downstream classic tool (not an LLM's context) fail I2.

B2: structure-aware TRAINING objectives (e.g., AST-aware fill-in-the-middle) without a context-construction mechanism fail I2/E4 — the map is about what enters the context, not how the model was trained.
B3: proof-assistant languages (Lean/Coq/Isabelle) count as code; theorem-proving agents with AST-based context mechanisms are in scope (I1 code QA/reasoning).
B4: surveys are included only when their primary object is context construction/retrieval for code LLMs; broader SE-agent surveys that merely touch context fail E4.
